reason: Development-time build tooling only; not shipped to end users. Style Dictionary runs against repository-controlled token files during builds, and its patched release requires glob 13, which is incompatible with the Bun-wide glob 11 resolution needed for the current CLI command-injection advisory. Tracked for proper resolution in #471.

Bun reports transitive Picomatch versions from frontend tooling. pnpm holds both affected majors on patched releases through the ranged pnpm.overrides entries, but Bun ignores ranged resolution keys such as 'picomatch@<2.3.2', so bun.lock keeps 2.3.1 and 4.0.3. A flat resolution cannot fix this without collapsing both majors onto one version and breaking the v2 consumers. Revisit when Bun supports ranged resolutions or the tooling drops Picomatch 2.

Both pnpm and Bun report this, so the entry is scoped to the frontend-pwa workspace ledger. extract-zip has no patched release; 2.0.1 is the latest published version and the advisory covers everything up to it. It reaches the tree only through puppeteer 23 via @puppeteer/browsers 2.x, which is used at build time to download a Mermaid rendering browser from Google's own endpoints, so no untrusted archive is extracted. The fix is @puppeteer/browsers 3.x, which replaced extract-zip with modern-tar and first ships in puppeteer 25.7; that is a two-major bump and scripts/install-mermaid-browser.mjs deep-imports puppeteer internals, so it needs its own change and verification.
